paragraphs: Software engineer and Computer Science graduate from San Diego State University (2025). I build full-stack web applications with React, Node.js and Express, and I'm especially interested in fintech and real-time data.
🎯 Open to Software Engineer, Frontend Developer and Full-Stack Developer roles.
features: A real-time momentum scanner that checks about 10,000 U.S. stocks every minute against five trading filters (price, % gain, relative volume, share float and fresh news) and sends sound and desktop alerts.
React, Vite, Node.js, Express, Alpaca and Massive market data APIs
Background scanning with server-side caching, batched API requests and retry handling for rate limits
Automated tests with Node's test runner, plus CI and deployment through GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages and Render
Search the Google Books catalog, create an account and keep a personal reading list.
